alternate_mechanisms: Provision and scarcity: divine facilitation opens toward productive increase, nourishment, and usable resources (ي س ر B006; ع ل م B005; ج ه ر B008), while resistant separation is imaged by scarcity (ج ن ب B008). This extends the ecological discovery without collapsing it into livestock or water imagery.

Visibility and warning: far sight, dazzled sight, faint hidden light, beacon, and fire (ش ي ء root_000831:B007/root_000832:B003; ج ه ر B004; خ ف ي B004; ن و ر B005/B002) form a spectrum in which manifestation can disclose, overwhelm, flicker, or guide. The reminder is effective through recognition, not exposure alone.

Ritual-moral purification: ج ن ب B004 encodes avoidance until purification, so the same root underlying يَتَجَنَّبُهَا is answered by تَزَكَّىٰ. Under the basmala, ك ب ر B009 adds divine magnification as a devotional counter-pole to self-exalting resistance.

Scalar outcome fork: slightness (ي س ر B002), abundant good or evil (ج ن ب B009), and maximal greatness (ك ب ر B001/B002) form a bounded quantity/value progression around ease, benefit, wretchedness, and the greatest fire.

Generational continuity and loss: ك ب ر B008 and م و ت B005 preserve the ranking's rare family/kinship bridge as an exploratory image of life continuity interrupted. It is non-surface and should not control the death-life antithesis.

Deathward agency without completed death: م و ت B010 reads avoidance as active self-endangerment leading into fire, while م و ت B001/B002/B012 and ح ي ي B001/B003/B006 hold the resulting subject between completed death and true life.

Genuine inward restraint versus performed abasement: reverent fear and purification can activate ح ي ي B005's modesty, contrasted with م و ت B011's feigned humility and aligned cautiously with م و ت B013's submission to truth.
